items.summary: -我們今天所知的英國王室只是一個非凡君主國的一代人，曾經統治這片土地的祖先是如何仍然屹立不倒的宏偉石頭建築，所有王室歷史都被記錄和保存下來。這是《英國君主制的全部歷史》。與一位名叫艾格伯特三世的撒克遜王子。公元771年埃格伯特三世出生時，不列顛群島的面貌反而是這樣的，出生於肯特國王埃蒙德，威塞克斯國王埃法的孫子，他的父親在埃格伯特10歲時去世，年輕的埃格伯特挑戰貝奧爾特里克的統治並失敗了。埃格伯特被迫到附近的麥西亞宮廷避難，被迫遵守自己的時間。埃格伯特成長為一位即將改變英國歷史進程的國王。西元800年，貝奧爾特里克死後，儘管在歐洲威塞克斯貴族中得到了壓倒性的支持，但來自附近王國的威脅仍然持續存在。西元802年，艾格伯特在麥西亞入侵軍的即位當天，最終加冕為威塞克斯國王。他控制了肯特郡、埃塞克斯郡、蘇塞克斯郡，甚至諾森布里亞王國最終都臣服於威塞克斯王冠，將所有盎格魯-撒克遜王國置於他的宿敵麥西亞王國之下，情況就不同了。在幾個世紀以來持續不斷的戰爭狀態中，每個王國都在交換領土和鮮血，威塞克斯國王埃格伯特取得了短暫的成功，將麥西亞國王趕出了他的土地，一年後，輪子又回來了。由於他在統一不列顛盎格魯撒克遜王國方面所發揮的作用，儘管他從未能夠完全征服他的統治，但他的統治永遠改變了不列顛的面貌。威塞克斯的埃格伯特製定了一項最終導致英國統一和英格蘭誕生的政策。在我們到達之前還有很多想念。威塞克斯國王埃格伯特於公元839年去世，他很快就面臨新的威脅：丹麥人。丹麥入侵於西元842年正式開始。西元851年的阿克利亞戰役（Battle of Aclea）將丹麥人趕回了大海，新的威脅讓不列顛王國非常擔憂，結束了近300年的衝突。這主要是因為新國王的決定，即使在這個時候也被認為是奇怪的。統治僅僅四年後，埃塞爾伯特就去世了。就像他的父親一樣，埃塞爾伯特也受到了拉格納·洛德布魯克和他的兒子無骨者伊瓦爾的威脅，維京軍隊甚至在公元865年洗劫了威塞克斯首府溫徹斯特。埃塞爾伯特集結軍隊，擊退維京人。西元867年，埃塞爾雷德即位，建立了丹麥第一個主要據點。西元871年，謹慎的國王埃塞爾伯特在雷丁戰役中被擊敗，同年在阿什當戰役中被擊敗。阿爾弗雷德像年輕人一樣不耐煩，他率領軍隊，他把維京人的寶藏買回來，買下了他兄弟的王國一段時間，再次襲擊了威塞克斯的軍隊，把王位留給了他的弟弟阿爾弗雷德。西元874年，偉大的異教徒軍隊迫使國王流亡。阿爾弗雷德完全控制了英格蘭。當丹麥軍隊包圍他時，他被盟友背叛了，而這些盟友現在選擇了談判。丹麥對英國的完全控制看起來迫在眉睫，年輕的國王並沒有放棄希望。讓駐紮在愛丁頓的丹麥軍隊感到驚訝的是，古斯魯姆堅持了兩週，要求離開威塞克斯並接受基督教洗禮。勝利後，阿爾弗雷德獲得了一個新名字：阿爾弗雷德大帝。阿爾弗雷德著手改造盎格魯撒克遜社會，他在整個王國建立了防禦城鎮，而北部和西部屬於丹麥人，則受丹麥法管轄。如今，這種分歧在英國的文化、政治和經濟上仍然存在。阿爾弗雷德將盎格魯撒克遜英格蘭帶入了黃金時代。西元899年，他的兒子老愛德華開啟了撒克遜統治的新時代。愛德華在很多方面都像他的父親，他的統治集中在兩件事上，即增加南北的擴張。他佔領了維京首都約克，也成功擊敗了維京人在英格蘭南部的存在，現在直接或間接統治所有舊王國，除了仍在維京人控制下的諾森布里亞。西元924年，老愛德華在鎮壓切斯特的麥西亞叛亂時受傷身亡。在鞏固了國內權力後，阿塞爾斯坦將目光轉向北方，征服島上最後的維京領土。他繼續向蘇格蘭領土進軍，迫使蘇格蘭國王向他宣誓稱霸。這使他成為阿塞爾斯坦建立英格蘭王國的第一位真正的統治者，因此被人們銘記為第一位真正的英國國王。現在，王國已牢牢地處於他的控制之下，國王阿瑟爾斯坦繼續推行在該王國進行大規模法律改革的政策，並關心歐洲政治。他於公元939年去世，將王位傳給了他同父異母的兄弟埃德蒙大帝。埃德蒙的統治幾乎完全集中在維持他同父異母兄弟的王國的統一上。他們起義反抗新國王，奪回約克。他率軍北上，短暫停留。他反對斯特拉斯克萊德國王，這使埃德蒙直接和間接地控制了整個大不列顛島。埃德蒙大帝未能逃脫暴力死亡。西元946年，在參加聖奧古斯丁彌撒時，國王曾因犯罪而驅逐他。埃德蒙大帝被埋葬在格拉斯頓伯里修道院由於埃德蒙的兩個兒子太小而無法統治，王位的重擔就落在了埃德蒙的弟弟埃德雷德身上，埃德蒙的長子埃德維格此時已經15歲，將王位據為己有。他決定在埃德加統治北方的同時瓜分自己的王國。國王埃德維希的統治時間很短，年輕的國王去世後，他於公元959年將整個英格蘭王國傳給了他的弟弟和平的埃德加。英國被認為是一個和平的黃金時代，英國沒有受到席捲全國的英國本篤會宗教改革的影響，但這種和平並沒有持續太久。公元975年他的去世將英格蘭推回了王位，而埃德加剩下的兩個兒子擾亂了王位，愛德華於公元975年成功登上王位，僅僅四年後就被謀殺，年僅12歲的弟弟埃塞爾雷德很快就掌權了。在年輕的國王下巴上還沒有長出一根頭髮之前，一個老敵人就從遙遠的北方崛起了。再次開始襲擊英國領土。隨著威脅一年比一年嚴重，英國國王很快集結大軍向北進軍，尋求妥協，國王埃塞爾雷德二世被迫向丹麥國王還錢，事實證明，丹麥國王斯文·福克比爾德航行到英國，迫使埃塞爾雷德於公元1013年逃往諾曼底。斯溫·福克比德（Sweyn Forkbeard）統治英格蘭僅四個星期，埃塞爾雷德（Aethelred）回歸並迅速重新控制了王位。儘管丹麥的中斷是短暫的，但它是所有盎格魯撒克遜國王中最長的一次，它將成為王室穩定的最後一個時期，直到近100年後的12世紀。西元1016年，無畏者埃塞爾雷德國王去世，王位傳給了他的兒子埃德蒙·艾恩賽德，現在他被迫收拾他父親製造的爛攤子。丹麥國王斯溫有一個兒子克努特大帝，在他父親去世幾週後，艾德蒙被迫與克努特和丹麥人交戰。埃德蒙受傷後，兩人達成了協議。埃德蒙·艾恩賽德將統治威塞克斯，而克努特則可以統治該國的其他地區。11月18日，埃德蒙去世，克努特接管了整個王國的王權。经过214年的霸权之后，威塞克斯家族正式失去了对英格兰的控制权，自公元802年埃格伯特三世以来统治不间断。1016年被證明是不列顛群島新時代的黎明，即丹麥人時代。經過幾個世紀的丹麥在島上的活動後，丹麥國王現在登上了英國王位。克努特大帝于公元1016年加冕，立即证明了他是一位精明的领导者，他所继承的土地的价值观与教会紧密结盟，所有这些都帮助克努特在公元1017年巩固了他的合法性。1018年，他加冕為丹麥國王，後來征服了瑞典，統一了三個王國。他的到來為英格蘭帶來了穩定。他於公元1035年去世，王位傳給了他的兒子哈羅德·哈雷福特。哈羅德並沒有改變繼承的第一選擇，而是任命哈羅德為國王。王國中的許多人反對，哈羅德努力鞏固自己的權力，她呼籲他們返回英格蘭奪回他們父親的王位。率領大軍橫渡英吉利海峽，尋求威塞克斯家族的支持。戈德溫最初反對哈羅德繼承王位，但後來背叛了年輕的王子，目的是將他交給哈羅德·兔腳。懺悔者愛德華逃回諾曼底，這次帶著他的母親逃到了安全的地方。最終於西元1036年因傷逝世。同年加冕為英格蘭國王。和他的兄弟一樣，他的統治也很短，他於公元1042年因不明疾病去世。他沒有兒子，在他生命的最後幾年，也許是受到母親諾曼底的艾瑪的鼓勵，他將這位同父異母的兄弟懺悔者愛德華從流放中召回，並任命他為繼承人。哈迪克特國王的去世將標誌著丹麥人最後一次坐政。愛德華登上王位後，英格蘭再次由盎格魯撒克遜國王統治，只不過愛德華只是真正的盎格魯撒克遜血統。他在諾曼第度過了25年的流亡生涯，對事物有著極度諾曼式的看法。他任命了諾曼議員，諾曼教會領袖選擇說法語而不是古英語。他最為人們所銘記的是威斯敏斯特教堂的創始人，該教堂至今仍是倫敦使用的主要地標。當愛德華的生命即將結束且沒有兒子繼承他時，人們期望愛德華選擇一個繼承人。他有兩個選擇：著名的威塞克斯伯爵哈羅德·戈德溫森和諾曼底公爵威廉。選擇哈羅德更具政治意義。他是盎格魯撒克遜人，出身於顯赫家族，與懺悔者愛德華國王的宮廷有聯繫。威廉曾是愛德華的助手。懺悔者愛德華的繼任過程中出現的問題是，國王想要什麼並不清楚。有傳言說他已將王位許諾給威廉。西元1065年，懺悔者愛德華從未明確說明誰將繼承英國王位。愛德華於1066年1月5日去世。一天后，哈羅德在新建的威斯敏斯特教堂加冕為英格蘭國王。聽到哈羅德即位的消息後，開始準備入侵島嶼。這將永遠塑造英格蘭。哈羅德國王發現自己處於不利的地位。預計諾曼公爵很快就會啟航，但由於天氣原因，航道變得崎嶇不平，威廉被迫推遲入侵。回到英格蘭，糧草開始耗盡，哈羅德被迫解散軍隊返回倫敦。1066年9月8日的同一天，一個新的威脅出現了，只不過這次是在遙遠的北方。挪威國王哈羅德·哈德拉達抵達諾森布里亞，擊敗英國伯爵，開始向北強行進軍近400公里。哈羅德國王和他的部下花了四天時間才到達現代的約克郡，但在9月25日，他們與挪威軍隊對峙，英國軍隊與挪威入侵者發生了衝突。哈羅德幾乎沒有時間休息。就在他在斯坦福橋獲勝兩天后，國王接到消息，諾曼入侵艦隊終於啟航前往英格蘭。他聚集了剩下的人，開始了400公里的行軍，大約7,000人在東蘇塞克斯的佩文西灣登陸。哈羅德國王和他的軍隊花了一周的時間哈羅德希望他的演講能抓住威廉·諾曼的偵察兵發現哈拉爾德的軍隊正在南下。1066年10月14日，一個永遠銘刻在英國歷史上的日子，兩軍發生了衝突。戰鬥從上午9:00開始，持續了一整天。英國的盾牆最初很堅固，讓諾曼公爵大吃一驚，迫使他後退，威廉是有備而來。雖然哈羅德只有步兵，但諾曼軍隊佯裝撤退，這促使英軍向前衝。哈羅德是英格蘭最後一位盎格魯撒克遜國王，被箭射中眼睛身亡。據報道，哈羅德的母親懇求威廉歸還她兒子的屍體，並提出支付與他兒子等重的黃金，讓英吉利海峽的波浪吞沒了撒克遜國王，從此再也見不到他。1066年聖誕節，他一路燃燒，穿越英格蘭南部，加冕，標誌著英格蘭諾曼時代的開始。為諾曼公爵贏得了一個新名字：征服者威廉。他殘酷地懲罰了那些反對他的人，處決了任何他認為對其統治構成威脅的人。或者在事件發生後迅速承諾支持威廉，有些人甚至被允許嫁入新王室。他最持久的政策之一是威廉在英格蘭的統治，最初用木頭建造，後來用石頭重建。從他第一次登陸的佩文西到如今的紐卡斯爾，歷史學家估計，僅在諾曼統治的頭20年裡，就有大約500人為威廉和那些忠於他的人提供了反對叛亂和篡奪者的職位，其中有很多叛亂和篡位者。威廉斯的第一個考驗是他的前盟友尤斯塔斯，他集結當地軍隊反對國王試圖佔領多佛城堡，但他失敗了，被迫歸還他贏得的土地。接下來，國王面臨內陸地區的一系列英國叛亂。西元1069年，威廉迅速平息了這些叛亂，北方起義，威廉做出了後來眾所周知的鎮壓，鎮壓如此殘酷，以至於離開了約克地區。有了這種穩定，國王感到足夠自信。1072年之後，他放棄了旅行，大部分時間都在諾曼第度過。正是在這段時間，有史以來第一次全國人口普查，這本戲劇性的《末日之書》實際上是對英格蘭所有土地的皇家調查。名字來自基督教的審判日。因為它讓歷史學家對倫敦邱園國家檔案館中諾曼入侵時期的生活有了難以置信的詳細了解。西元1087年9月9日，征服者威廉死於痢疾，羅伯特得到諾曼底，威廉得到英格蘭，亨利，亨利得到金錢。雖然新國王威廉在父親去世一個月後加冕為王，但他很快就確立了自己不受歡迎的地位。因此，在統治了13年後，國王威廉二世在一次狩獵事故中結束了生命，這也許並不奇怪。射箭者威廉·提雷爾國王威廉二世死後，王位將傳給他的哥哥諾曼底公爵羅伯特，而三人中最年輕的亨利卻有其他想法。由於羅伯特在大陸上忙碌，亨利於公元1100年控制了倫敦的皇家金庫，宣布自己為英格蘭國王。羅伯特最終確實向他的弟弟挑戰了英國王位，但亨利國王取得了勝利，值得慶幸的是，亨利一世比他的弟弟在他之前是一個更好的統治者。全面推動依法治國，法治進一步鞏固。他統治了35年漫長、和平和繁榮的時期，當時亨利國王任命了新人，悲劇在他的晚年降臨。他的兒子、英國王位的最終繼承人威廉·阿德林死於白船失事。當亨利顯然不會再生一個兒子時，他決定給女兒起名為瑪蒂爾達，而許多男爵公開宣誓效忠國王亨利一世於公元1135年去世。然而，英格蘭的男爵們立刻放棄了已故國王的願望，轉而支持另一個宣稱者，即亨利的侄子。你看，英國貴族並不熱衷於這個想法一個女人統治國家。英國社會認為女性根本無法像男性那樣有效地統治。亨利國王去世的消息首先傳到了布盧瓦的史蒂芬，他於公元1135年跨過英吉利海峽加冕為國王，認為土地的穩定優先於支持瑪蒂爾達作為亨利的繼承人。她父親去世的消息很慢才傳到她那裡。史蒂芬國王享受了早期統治時期尋求支持反對篡位國王。麻煩始於1141年，當時國王的軍隊據說英勇作戰，被俘虜的國王被帶去與瑪蒂爾達交談。她立刻將史蒂芬囚禁在布里斯托城堡，出發前往倫敦，心中只有一個目標：她的加冕禮，她成為女王的企圖很快就停止了。瑪蒂爾達皇后被迫撤退，她同父異母的弟弟羅伯特被俘，瑪蒂爾達皇后確保了她同父異母弟弟的安全。史蒂芬再次獲釋後，戰鬥仍在繼續。瑪蒂爾達皇后本人在迪韋齊斯鎮被捕，並設法逃離國王的追隨者。她再次被捕，這次被關在牛津城堡，瑪蒂達再次勇敢地逃脫，逃離了匆忙組成的希望找到她的搜查隊。戰爭很快就陷入僵局。1153年，瑪蒂爾達的兒子亨利登陸英國，開始與權力貴族建立自己的聯盟，以支持他母親的王位繼承權。瑪蒂爾達皇后厭倦了戰鬥，史蒂芬國王也處於類似的境地，他的統治也因不斷的戰鬥而受到破壞。它表示，史蒂芬國王將終身保留國王，並在他死後繼承他成為英格蘭國王。事實證明，史蒂芬只活了一年就於公元1154年去世，將英國王位傳給了亨利。英格蘭在一個新的家族的統治下重生，這個家族最終於公元1154年12月19日統治了該島，十八年的內戰已經造成了損失，他祖父統治的地方領主的王國慢慢地從王室手中奪走了權力，削弱了它在王國中的影響力。亨利首先恢復了王室行政權力，並重建了英國對威爾斯的霸權。在斯蒂芬國王統治時期。接下來，亨利專注於恢復王室的財政。亨利繼承的王國已經損失了約46%的資金。他的名字叫做湯瑪斯‧貝克特。1155年貝克特被任命為大法官，亨利國王對大法官非常欽佩。作為一個新人，貝克特擁護亨利祖父提出的想法，除此之外，兩人很快就成為了朋友。當坎特伯雷大主教去世時，國王甚至派遣了他的兒子亨利，亨利看到了千載難逢的機會。為了重申自己對英格蘭教會的權利，近年來，國王亨利二世以大主教的新職位向亨利國王尋求支持。亨利在他的老朋友公元1162年受任命後幾乎立即將自己塑造成新的宗教權利保護者。簡單來說，亨利在位期間，國王不喜歡這樣，因為這讓英國的行政機構由神職人員組成的王室顯得軟弱，亨利急於從教會手中奪回權力。應該在皇家法庭受審。這激怒了以極度擔心自己的生命安全而聞名的國王亨利二世，大主教貝克特逃往法國，貝克特一回來就激怒了亨利，亨利又勃然大怒，連著四晚，也許是希望討好國王，亨利對此深感後悔。亨利國王步行前往坎特伯雷大教堂，教會的權力因此增長。亨利自己的滅亡最終會到來。1173年，英國王位繼承人年輕的亨利背叛了他的父親。在他的兩個兄弟理查德和傑弗裡以及幾個歐洲國家的加入下，大起義開始了，國王亨利二世被迫與叛軍作戰。多虧了亨利的才華橫溢的當地指揮官，年輕的亨利和杰弗裡在十年後的1183年領導了另一場叛亂，但他們再次失敗，法國國王菲利普二世將中立的理查德拉到了自己一邊，他們一起領導了針對英格蘭國王亨利二世的最後一次叛亂。國王撤退到安茹的城堡，並於1189年因潰瘍出血而去世。在迫使父親下台後，理查一世在威斯敏斯特教堂加冕為國王，參加了後來被稱為第三次十字軍東徵的戰爭。理查國王在英國祇待了10個月，然後就離開英國，加入了法國腓力二世的十字軍東徵。理查國王證明了自己是一位出色的軍事戰略家。英格蘭很快就被拋在腦後。他主要利用這個王國來資助他的戰爭。理查國王被英國國王的私人敵人奧地利的利奧波德俘虜並勒索贖金。亨利二世最小的孩子約翰被任命為王國的行政負責人。當他得知弟弟被捕的消息時，他猶豫是否要支付6萬英鎊的贖金。理查國王的贖金已支付，他再次獲得自由。獅心王理查生前在戰鬥中死去。所有人都清楚，國王不會成功。據報道，理查要求將弓弩手帶到他面前，他感到很驚訝。孩子說理查國王殺死了他的父親和兄弟。他原以為會被處決，但在最後的仁慈之舉中，理查於1199年4月6日死在他母親的懷裡。當時的編年史家這樣描述了國王的死，約翰於公元1199年加冕為英格蘭國王。約翰也被賦予了一個綽號，儘管這個綽號遠沒有那麼浪漫。他被稱為約翰·拉克蘭（John Longshanks)在過去56年經歷了三次重大叛亂，成為英格蘭國王後不久，在威斯敏斯特教堂加冕。愛德華國王一世有他的工作要做。他立即開始改革王室行政，愛德華也從他父親的錯誤中吸取了教訓，很快就被證明是一個有能力和公正的統治者。愛德華國王無能為力第一次是1282年威爾斯酋長盧韋林(Llywelyn)領導的威爾斯叛亂。在這裡，皇家軍隊面對面。愛德華國王建造了一系列城堡，增加了皇家在該地區的影響力。他的兒子愛德華於1284年出生於威爾斯。1291年，另一場外國衝突引起了他的注意，為了爭奪蘇格蘭王位，愛德華選擇加冕約翰·巴利奧爾。此前曾向英國國王致敬，這激怒了蘇格蘭領主，他們反過來與法國結盟，使英格蘭受到四面楚歌的威脅。為自己奪得蘇格蘭王冠。所有蘇格蘭國王都在這裡加冕。如今，這塊石頭仍被用來為英國君主加冕，目前存放在倫敦威斯敏斯特教堂。愛德華國王為自己贏得了一個新綽號。愛德華·長腿成為了蘇格蘭之鎚愛德華。回到英格蘭，愛德華正在監督處理皇家財政的財政法庭，為了保持他的新法庭順利運轉，他將法律職業從神職人員手中奪走，形成了一個由受過教育的年輕人組成的新社會階層。大律師向學生們教授英國普通法，這些法院也開創了先例，這是在200多年前阿爾弗雷德大帝統治時期的愛德華國王時期。1307年，國王愛德華一世在北部與蘇格蘭人作戰時首次死於痢疾。爱德华希望在军队继续向苏格兰作战时将他的骨头带走。另一种谣言称，当他们再次踏入圣地时，爱德华希望得到他的心。爱德华非常认为自己是一位战士国王。虽然他是一位成功的军事指挥官，但这对整个英格兰影响最大。愛德華國王的統治是和平繁榮的，愛德華一世國王由他的兒子愛德華二世繼承，而他的父親立即發動了愛德華二世的行動。作为全欧洲最强大的王国之一。新国王爱德华似乎转向了其他的追求，年轻人。国王将会和皮尔斯·加维斯顿在一起。加威斯頓性格傲慢，深知自己的地位，是國王的親密伴侶，很快，加韋斯頓的行為激怒了愛德華二世通過妻子嫁給的法國王室，愛德華二世國王被迫流放皮爾斯·加韋斯頓，這並沒有持續多久。1307年，加韦斯顿再次回到英格兰，侍奉国王身边。1308年，议会与国王会面。国王再次召回加韦斯顿，在国王和贵族军队之间，加韦斯顿最终在斯卡伯勒城堡被俘。英国统治了仅仅18年之后，苏格兰仍为朋友的死而震惊，1314年，苏格兰再次获得独立。国王任命了一位新宠休·勒·德斯潘塞(Hugh Le Despenser)，以缓和他在海外的损失。德斯潘塞和他的家族日益強大，殺害加維斯頓的蘭開斯特伯爵率領的軍隊與愛德華二世國王展開了對決。蘭開斯特伯爵嚐到了自己的苦果，於1326年在龐特弗拉克特城堡被斬首。德斯潘塞家族的勢力不斷增強，現在在整個英格蘭的影響力激增。伊莎貝拉女王再次被迫介入。伊莎貝拉女王起兵國王擊敗了愛德華國王和他的軍隊，伊莎貝拉女王迫使國王愛德華二世退位。愛德華三世將接替他的位置。當英國王冠落在他頭上時，他只有15歲，但在這位年輕的國王開始著手修復他的王國之前，羅傑·莫蒂默接替了他作為攝政王進行統治。愛德華國王討厭這個。愛德華對他的母親越來越不滿，國王愛德華三世反抗攝政王，完全控制了英國王室。粉碎了他們的軍隊並奪回了他父親失去的土地。會吸引愛德華國王的全部注意力。1337年，法國國王菲利普六世像他父親一樣沒收了英國國王的阿基坦公國，愛德華國王做出了血腥衝突的回應，這場衝突將奪走愛德華在技術上對法國王位的所有權，這只給了男性繼承人繼承權的權利，無論如何，愛德華三世國王已經準備好戰鬥。戰爭的第一階段對英格蘭來說進展順利。英國在歐洲大陸上取得了領土，迫使愛德華放棄了自己的主張。兩個王國之間的戰鬥很快又重新開始，事實上，整個歐洲都在遭受打擊。1348年，黑死病抵達了英國。許多人認為黑死病是上帝自己的詛咒，短短五年內就奪走了歐洲1/3到一半的人口。愛德華國王很幸運，英格蘭主要城市的居住條件過於擁擠，死亡人數高得難以想像，導致勞動力短缺，嚴重影響了英國經濟。許多地主被迫圈地，養羊需要1/5的人力，一個新的階級出現了，自由勞工。許多人在大城市定居，愛德華三世國王的王國看起來幾乎認不出來了。進一步發展了立法和政府的作用，他在英國王位上的50年使他成為統治時間最長的國王。他於1377年6月21日去世，比他自己的兒子黑太子更長壽。愛德華的孫子理查二世。理查是一位年輕的國王，年僅10歲就首次戴上王冠，岡特的約翰是第一位接任的實際統治者。1337年理查三世加冕後，愛德華國王的最後幾年因疾病和年老而臥床不起，他介入了。愛德華的長期統治絕非一帆風順，法國入侵該島，英國軍隊無法與之抗衡。岡特的約翰引入了一項新的人頭稅，要求每個15歲以上的人為非洲大陸的戰爭貢獻一先令。所有這些因素結合在一起，形成了對理查國王的統治構成極大威脅的重大事件。在牧師約翰·鮑爾的帶領下，十萬人在倫敦遊行，這是一場被稱為「農民起義」的重大起義。抗議者燒毀了薩沃伊宮，國王理查二世和倫敦市長、另一位領導人瓦特泰勒開始辱罵。由於擔心人群再次變得暴力，這位年輕的國王採取了異常勇敢的舉動。帶領他們離開領袖的屍體，國王永遠不會忘記他的議會的行動，直到它只包括三名男子，而這三名男子反過來變得極其強大，擔心他們的權力很快就會因此而減弱。成立一個名為上議院上訴人的團體。1387年，他們控制了英國政府，要求國王將他的核心集團逐出宮廷。最終國王被迫放逐。在接下來的十年裡，脆弱的和平得以維持，理查國王慢慢地將其從無情的議會中奪走。1397年，國王已經累積了足夠的支持。1398年，理查的暴政更進一步，成立了一個由12名領主和6名平民組成的委員會，實際上使理查德成為理查統治蘭開斯特家族的絕對統治者。理查國王流放了約翰的兒子亨利·博林布魯克，蘭開斯特家族仍然阻礙他。約翰是愛德華三世國王在世的最小的兒子，許多人都希望蘭開斯特家族能夠繼承沒有孩子的理查德，但對理查德來說幸運的是，岡特的約翰於1399年去世，給了國王時間來鞏固自己的權力。理查德覺得自己已經有效地應對了蘭開斯特的威脅，於是他將注意力轉向了他。他集結了一支由8,000人組成的軍隊，於1399年5月離開英國，一周內登陸都柏林，但僅僅一個月後，法國國王查理六世就被路易一世廢黜，新的法國國王看到了對抗英國敵人的機會。路易允許亨利·博林布魯克帶著一支小部隊返回英格蘭，亨利很快就在那裡聚集了更多的支持。理查在愛爾蘭作戰，很快就在戰鬥中擊敗了國王理查二世。後來在倫敦塔內餓死。雖然亨利對王位的要求微弱，但亨利·博林布魯克於1399年9月30日加冕為亨利四世。亨利四世的統治創造了一系列的第一。用英語而不是諾曼法語向他的人民講話。1400年加冕後不久，他還接待了曼努埃爾二世·帕里奧洛戈斯(Manuel II Palaiologos)的訪問。1406年，英國海盜在約克郡海岸俘獲了這位年僅11歲的年輕王子，他將繼續被亨利四世囚禁。亨利四世國王的統治基本上平靜無事。來自國外的叛亂，以及1400年北方第一代諾森伯蘭伯爵亨利·珀西領導的針對歐文·格林多的叛亂。亨利的長子蒙茅斯的亨利表現出了非凡的軍事才能，帶領他的軍隊對珀西的軍隊取得了決定性的勝利。然而，在戰鬥中，蒙茅斯的亨利很快就在倫敦傳出理查二世的謠言，以證明理查在被囚禁期間死亡。亨利國王在理查去世後不久將他的屍體陳列在保羅大教堂，表明老國王實際上已經去世了，但這並沒有阻止蘇格蘭使者走遍英格蘭的各個村莊。不出所料，叛亂毫無結果。亨利的健康狀況反覆惡化。亨利在倫敦方丈之家逝世。1413年4月9日，英國國王蒙茅斯的亨利國王仍然以人民的身份發表演說。這位年輕的國王在他父親統治期間就養成了對戰爭的興趣。年僅16歲的他就在什魯斯伯里戰役中幫助平息了威爾斯叛亂。亨利五世繼承了許多同樣的問題。蘭開斯特派的主張遭到了相當多的懷疑者，他們開始著手確保他的王位地位。光榮地重新安葬了已故的理查二世，賜予理查的兒子埃德蒙·莫蒂默，他無情地平息了1414年羅拉德派的不滿，他們支持埃德蒙·莫蒂默繼承王位，但未能獲得太多民眾的支持。在整個情節中向國王。他提倡在政府中使用英語，這是自諾曼征服以來的第一次。百年戰爭仍在進行中。1415年，國王亨利五世率領一支軍隊，亨利五世率領軍隊佔領了哈佛勒爾市，帶著12,000人到達諾曼底，亨利的軍隊現在只剩下6,000人。他命令他的軍隊穿過法國鄉村，向英國控制的港口城市加萊進發。法國軍隊的人數與他們成五比一，上午11:00，法軍發動進攻，以騎兵直接向英軍主線衝鋒。憑藉250公尺的殺傷範圍，當騎兵到達英國戰線時，由英國人對抗法國人。最終，英國弓箭手放棄了弓箭，很快轉而支持英國軍隊。他的軍隊毫無抵抗地在加萊進軍。幾個月後，當他回到英國時，這是英格蘭的一個偉大的驕傲時刻，事實證明這是英國最偉大的勝利，它極大地支持了亨利五世對法國王位的要求。這直接導致了法國宮廷內部的內訌，到了1420年，《特魯瓦條約》簽訂，承認亨利為攝政王和法國王位繼承人。至此，亨利重新控制了諾曼底，並得到了匈牙利國王西吉斯蒙德的支持，英法似乎已勢在必行。亨利的目的是在統一兩個王位後，幾年後即1422年去世，將王位傳給他的兒子亨利六世。雖然亨利五世的統治時間很短，但英格蘭再次在大陸上佔有一席之地，在亨利國王的領導下，英格蘭達到了領土頂峰。亨利六世於1422年9月1日在威斯敏斯特教堂加冕。年輕的國王在王國裡並不是什麼新鮮事，亨利六世打破了英國的所有記錄，僅九個月就登上王位，很快就落入了一起統治英格蘭的攝政王手中。幾年前，亨利國王的父親在巴黎聖母院簽署了加冕禮，小亨利國王前往法國加冕為法國國王。這使得亨利六世國王成為唯一在法國領土上加冕為法國國王的英國國王。亨利的母親凱瑟琳改嫁給歐文·都鐸，亨利將諾曼第的伯爵爵位賜給了同父異母的兄弟，他們的影響力對後來產生了巨大的影響。到了16歲的時候，亨利已經恢復了對英格蘭的完全權威控制。它來得不是時候。這將持續接下來的五十年，削弱了王室在王國中的權力。亨利六世在中世紀時期與他的父親完全不同，這使他在法庭上顯得軟弱。國王容易陷入瘋狂的狀態，迫使他做出行政決策，這使得英格蘭不穩定並削弱了王室權威。互相爭吵、集結私人軍隊的國王會斷斷續續地恢復統治，更糟的是，在一百年戰爭中英格蘭屢獲戰果和勝利，亨利失去了父親在法國的所有土地，進一步加深了他軟弱國王的形象。沒多久，英格蘭隊就爆發了，而亨利則努力保持自己的理智。約克家族自稱是愛德華三世的後裔，愛德華三世是金雀花王朝的國王，在亨利·博林布魯克以武力登上王位不到一百年前，約克家族正準備向英國王位發動攻擊。1460年7月10日，俘虜亨利國王並成為約克派囚犯。然而，女王在韋克菲爾德戰役中擊敗約克軍隊並釋放了國王後，成功逃脫，穿越威爾斯進入蘇格蘭。隨著周圍的戰鬥愈演愈烈，亨利此時的精神狀態已經是支離破碎。然而，蘭開斯特家族的勝利是短暫的，在1461年的陶頓戰役中與皇家軍隊相遇。愛德華將亨利六世從王位廢黜，儘管如此，戰爭仍將繼續。亨利六世最終被背叛。新國王愛德華決定饒了這位瘋狂國王的性命，而是將他關進了倫敦塔。1461年6月28日，約克的愛德華加冕為愛德華四世，他迫切需要議會的支持來支持他的主張，英格蘭的許多領主仍然支持老國王亨利，主要是沃里克伯爵理查德·內維爾。爱德华四世国王失去了对英国王冠的控制。沃里克在过去十年中曾建议国王娶法国在欧洲有影响力的安妮。一个比国王社会阶层低得多的女人这激怒了沃里克，他开始在其他地方寻找盟友。1467年，愛德華國王給了沃里克又一次羞辱性的打擊，內維爾的軍隊輕鬆擊敗了皇家軍隊國王的岳父理查德·伍德維爾認為沃里克在首都幾乎沒有什麼支持，愛德華國王約克派的統治越來越不得人心，沃里克得以集結了一支三萬大軍於1470年9月9日登陸英格蘭，愛德華國王根本不是沃里克的對手。沃里克率軍恢復了亨利六世的王位，困擾瘋狂國王統治的問題又捲土重來，導致貴族之間為了權力而互相爭鬥，而愛德華則立即返回英格蘭，在約克尋求支持。他穿过王国，慢慢集结了一支军队，再次囚禁了亨利六世。沃里克在1471年的巴尼特战役中阵亡，第二支兰开斯特军队被击败，不到一年后亨利本人也去世了。隨著老國王和他的繼承人的去世，愛德華國王希望他的王位現在能夠穩固，愛德華國王能夠保持對權力的控制，在他的統治即將結束時，他病情日益嚴重，於1483年4月9日去世。他的兒子愛德華五世將接任英格蘭國王，國王任命他的兄弟格洛斯特公爵理查德為愛德華成年時的護國主和攝政王。愛德華永遠不會加冕英格蘭很快就會發現，在他的兄弟愛德華四世國王去世後，新的護國主理查立即接任了王國的護國主。王室記錄確實顯示，這一計劃使理查德贏得了冷酷權力掠奪者的名聲，他殘酷地鎮壓了一個涉嫌危害他生命的陰謀，該陰謀涉及新國王的叔叔安東尼·伍德維爾。理查德和安東尼·伍德維爾將在北安普頓會面，陪同年輕的愛德華前往首都，而年輕的國王等待叔叔的到來，理查德則開始工作。這些人因涉嫌陰謀殺害新護國公而受到審判並被處決。理查德很快通知他的侄子，太后逃往首都，理查德與國王愛德華四世與伊麗莎白·伍德維爾的婚姻只有一個障礙，因為愛德華國王在與伍德維爾結合時仍然與埃莉諾·巴特勒結婚。這意味著愛德華和理查在新國王加冕之日，要求理查直接掌控王位。1483年7月6日，護國公理查加冕為英格蘭國王理查三世。塔中王子之謎仍然是英國歷史上最大的懸而未決的問題之一。他的權力基礎還很脆弱，沒多久，那些對老國王愛德華四世極度忠誠的人，就悄悄策劃推翻了新國王理查。他們看到了新政權的本質，這是一場權力攫取，他們希望將王冠交還給目前在倫敦塔的年輕愛德華王子。當愛德華王子去世的傳言傳出時，亨利都鐸已準備好並願意橫渡英吉利海峽。身為瑪格麗特·博福特夫人的兒子，愛德華三世的後裔，亨利對英國王位有合法的繼承權，白金漢在威爾斯集結軍隊，而亨利·都鐸則像1066年一樣被流放到法國，惡劣的天氣再次發揮了重要作用。亨利和他的船隻因猛烈風暴而推遲穿越英吉利海峽，當理查的軍隊抵達迎戰叛軍時，當亨利聽說白金漢的命運時，他逃離了一年後，即1485年，他帶著一支新的軍隊入侵巴黎。8月22日，亨利都鐸國王理查三世的軍隊在博斯沃思戰場會面。戰鬥記錄聲稱，國王的軍隊被理查三世分為三個主力部隊。自30年前玫瑰戰爭爆發以來，這場戰鬥始於理查國王，伯爵伯爵能夠給斯坦利伯爵的兒子威廉·斯坦利爵士造成嚴重傷亡。當愛德華四世登基時，理查甚至在他登基後獎勵了他北威爾斯的土地。理查德擔心他可能很快就會失去對軍隊的控制，因此推遲加入任何一方。他打算直接衝進亨利都鐸的軍隊，加入了亨利都鐸的一邊，包圍了理查國王和他的部下。據報道，理查國王帶著亨利都鐸的一把劍前來，最終被擊敗，理查三世的統治結束了。他將是最後一位在戰鬥中陣亡的英國國王。它被取下並放在亨利都鐸的頭上。理查的屍體未經儀式就被埋葬了。他的死標誌著玫瑰戰爭的正式結束，理查三世成為最後一位金雀花王朝國王，英格蘭有了新國王。亨利·都鐸(Henry Tudor)在約克威斯敏斯特教堂加冕為亨利七世，共同組成了新家族「都鐸」(Tudor)。一旦他的統治者地位更加穩固，英格蘭就急需修復。值得慶幸的是，幾十年的內戰和過去三年兩年的耐心已經離開了這個王國，亨利國王證明了新國王相信所謂的王室專制主義，而不必向貴族、教會或議會負責。這導致亨利採取了更親力親為的方法，成為一名非常有能力的管理者和外交官。內戰對財政部來說從來都不是好事，在經濟大蕭條時期經過30年的戰鬥後，他獲得了《馬格努斯·Intercursus》或《偉大協議》所放棄的所有土地。幾個世紀後的今天，英國的羊毛貿易已經爆炸式增長，成為島上對歐洲的主要經濟出口。當勃艮地的瑪格麗特支持珀金·沃貝克時，亨利在位期間被迫應對。國王對勃艮第實施了貿易禁運，英國羊毛從巴黎到羅馬受到珍視，該條約重新開放了兩國之間的貿易，由於取消了進入歐洲的英國商品的稅收而對英國大為優惠，亨利在位期間發生了兩次重大起義。一個被迫假裝亨利國王的小男孩在饒恕男孩的生命方面表現出了極大的仁慈，下一個是珀金·沃貝克，一個更嚴重的威脅沃貝克也被擊敗了，但與蘭伯特·西姆內爾不同，總而言之，亨利七世國王的統治長達24年，王室的影響力歡迎亨利國王帶來的穩定，他統治的後期歲月被標記一年後，他失去了妻子伊麗莎白女王，據報道將自己鎖了起來數週，亨利國王從未真正康復的是他的兒子約克公爵亨利繼位。沒有哪個英國國王比亨利八世更出名，但他實際上從來沒有打算成為國王。亨利七世國王的長子是威爾斯親王亞瑟。他出生於1486年，一生都在宮廷接受訓練，準備接替他的父親。年僅15歲的亞瑟就與凱瑟琳結婚，倖存下來，而亞瑟不幸去世。歷史對亨利八世並不仁慈，這位都鐸國王經常因兩件主要事情而被人們銘記，這與亨利實際上被認為是年輕國王亨利的特質形成鮮明對比，而亨利可能在法庭上給人留下了深刻的印象，亨利有一個聽他講話的議會成員托馬斯·莫爾爵士，為亨利服務。亨利國王任命沃西樞機主教掌管英格蘭。儘管國王盡了最大努力讓英格蘭破產，但她仍然能夠維持英格蘭的生存。沃爾西是最成功的新人之一，任命沃爾西為教皇甚至經過了認真的考慮。由於英國在整個歐洲所扮演的角色正在經歷重大的宗教動盪，因此許多改革者稱英國為自己的家。亨利國王脫離天主教會亨利實際上是宗教保守派，亨利得到了教皇的特殊特許。很長一段時間，兩人的婚姻幸福美滿，隨著歲月的流逝，一個問題很快就顯現出來。與阿拉貢的凱瑟琳結婚24年後，他們只生了一個孩子，瑪麗。亨利回到了他的專家總理沃爾西紅衣主教身邊。他解雇了沃爾西，並指控他叛國。亨利很快發現自己正在與時間賽跑。任何其他女人所生的孩子都是非法的，迫使他們宣布他的第一次婚姻無效。然而令亨利沮喪的是，這是一個女孩，亨利的行為不僅激怒了神職人員，還激怒了西班牙阿拉貢王國，引發了一場衝突，亨利決定親自處理此事。自從偉大的盎格魯撒克遜王國時代以來，亨利現在是英國國教的領袖，亨利主張最大的權力，亨利八世對這次殺戮深感遺憾。在安妮·博林未能向亨利提供資訊後，亨利相信她與她的兄弟有染。她成功地為亨利生下了一個男性繼承人愛德華，傷心欲絕的國王對她的去世深感悲痛。然而，1540年，他被說服與克利夫斯的安妮結婚，隨後亨利也宣布婚姻無效。同年，他與19歲的凱瑟琳霍華德(Catherine Howard)結婚。他的最後一位妻子凱瑟琳·帕爾(Catherine Parr)有幸在55歲的亨利(Henry)的遺體旁成為寡婦，與他的第三任妻子簡·西摩(Jane Seymour)的遺體在一起。亨利八世於1547年2月20日去世，他相信自己已經加冕，他的王國由叔叔愛德華·西摩(Edward Seymour)領導的攝政委員會統治。愛德華是第一位英國國王。前者很大程度上是他父親亨利八世的禮物，愛德華六世對蘇格蘭發動進攻，最終以和平告終，英格蘭很快就陷入了困境。當亨利脫離天主教會時，愛德華國王卻完全信奉新教，英國通過了大規模的宗教改革。這迫使英國農民將星期日作為強制休息日。愛德華六世國王的健康狀況不佳。1553年，愛德華患病去世。亨利七世的孫女珍‧格雷夫人。正如王室繼承的常見情況一樣，愛德華於7月6日去世。她努力爭取王室以外的支持。瑪麗在東安格利亞集結了一支軍隊，進軍倫敦並廢黜了簡，瑪麗女王成為英格蘭第一位攝政王。而瑪麗則成功奪取了王冠的控制權，為女王贏得了一個新名字：血腥瑪麗。與新教徒的衝突對瑪麗來說還不夠，是議會阻止了瑪麗與西班牙菲利普（本人是虔誠的天主教徒）的許多反改革，基本上阻止了他在1558年繼承王位，瑪麗一世女王病重。王位將傳給瑪麗的妹妹，自亨利八世統治以來，她就一直控制著英格蘭。她被加冕為伊麗莎白一世女王。在伊莉莎白女王統治下，英國國教在形式上仍然是天主教徒，宗教仍然構成巨大威脅，因為她很快就面臨來自北方的天主教起義，瑪麗要求繼承英國王位，伊莉莎白女王感到受到瑪麗的威脅。蘇格蘭女王瑪麗於1587年因叛國罪被處死。來自國內事務和更多的國際威脅。由克里斯多福·哥倫布(Christopher Bland）永遠不會成為王后。僅僅幾年後，威廉就找到了一位合適的妻子。她在生育的黃金時期是皇室成員，但在喬治三世國王的統治下，她的生育能力遭受了巨大的損失。威廉國王大聲表達了他對生下喬治·華盛頓的遺憾，英美關係在他的統治下穩步改善，兩國關係至今仍很接近。據報道，為了活下去見到侄女滿18歲，阿德萊德公主一直陪伴在他身邊，隨著他的健康狀況惡化，她已經10天拒絕睡覺。國王威廉四世在凌晨去世。年僅18歲的維多利亞發現自己成為了世界上最偉大帝國的領導者。40萬人前往首都，呼籲男性普選權席捲整個王國。1846年，《穀物法》被廢除，自由貿易獲勝，維多利亞女王尋求參與政治。由於禁止英國君主的法律，女王試圖在維多利亞時代英國黑暗的政治世界中影響政府的結果，第一屆世界博覽會於1851年在倫敦舉行。而世界博覽會可能支持了這些想法，正式成為維多利亞女王印度。曾與英國東印度公司共事的女王向她的新臣民承諾了權利和自由。回到倫敦，維多利亞女王在一場反對王室機構的潛在革命中恢復了公眾視野中的生活，但繼續哀悼，直到去世那天，她都穿著黑色衣服。女王在沒有王子的情況下又統治了40年，阿瑟·柯南·道爾爵士寫下了《夏洛克·福爾摩斯》，查爾斯·狄更斯出版了一些最偉大的作品。繼喬治三世國王之後，維多利亞女王的63年統治仍然是一個標誌性的篇章。1901年，維多利亞女王在前往奧斯本宮的途中因中風去世，享年81歲。英國不得不把古老的女王拋在身後愛德華七世國王是許多比喻的例證在他作為威爾士親王期間，愛德華國王監督了王位的更替愛德華國王借鑒了他母親的書愛德華國王統治著一個正在迅速變化的島嶼。自從國王埃格伯特統治以來，大量貧窮的英國臣民已經接受了教育。愛德華七世國王面臨憲法危機，以幫助資助英國各地的社會住宅計畫。下議院通過了，愛德華七世國王正是在這場騷亂中死於憲法危機，年輕的喬治是愛德華國王的次子，青年時期在海外皇家海軍服役，維多利亞公主、泰克瑪麗，喬治加冕為英國皇帝，得益於1911年的議會法案，喬治五世國王對德國宣戰。「我在10點45分召開會議，向德國宣戰。因為他們都是維多利亞女王和阿爾伯特親王。因此，英國國王喬治五世於1917年7月17日將他的姓氏改為溫莎王室。監禁他並建立蘇聯。喬治國王擔心羅曼諾夫家族的到來。1926年，喬治國王成為核心人物。1931年，威斯敏斯特法規賦予了他權力。他於1937年5月12日加冕，廣受好評，謠言傳遍全國，新國王喬治有語言障礙和口吃，喬治國王在北美巡迴演出。你看，喬治國王和歐洲其他國家一樣，1939年希特勒入侵波蘭後，歐洲爆發了戰爭。倫敦遭受了閃電戰，一天晚上兩枚德國炸彈落在了王宮花園。他的女兒伊莉莎白公主甚至應徵入伍，溫斯頓邱吉爾接任首相。雖然喬治國王最初對邱吉爾猶豫不決，但喬治國王甚至訪問了法國、義大利的軍隊，喬治國王給了他們想要的東西，喬治國王甚至在第一次集會上發言。喬治國王被任命為新英聯邦元首，澳洲和紐西蘭仍然承認國王接管許多王室職責。喬治國王前往倫敦機場，六天后，喬治六世國王被發現死在桑德靈厄姆城堡的床上，享年56歲。25歲時，伊莉莎白公主登上英國王位，成為英國女王伊莉莎白二世。出來見正在進行國事訪問的女王。女王看到了英國尋求加入歐洲共同體的政治權力，那一年十月，在對新西蘭進行國事訪問期間，一名入侵者闖入白金漢宮，安德魯王子與妻子莎拉分居，安妮公主與長子查爾斯王子正式離婚，使戴安娜王妃深受公眾歡迎，女王帶著年幼的孫子們去巴爾莫勒爾堡，那年夏天，女王為2012年奧運會開幕，2015年奧運會開幕，2015年2015年，維多利亞二世統治了15年奧運會，2015年奧運會。幾年後，她成為第一位英國君主。2022年，她庆祝了自己的白金禧年，标志着英国王位登基70周年。在法国国王路易十四的历史上，她于英国标准时间15点10分安详去世。国王查理三世是众多公开支持气候变化、王室改革的人士中最新的一位。他与戴安娜育有两个儿子，英国王位继承人威廉王子和哈里王子。73歲登基的查理三世國王成為最年長的國王，儘管他已年事已高，但王國正在經歷巨大的變化，查理三世國王可能是英國最後一位國王嗎？

pastures and Fields on fire and turned their machine guns on any cattle or animals that they could not take away by train all religious acts and processions were suspended the churches were closed later plundered and used as Stables troops this situation must have seemed nothing short of apocalyptic for Ramirez he once even received a letter from his brother explaining how he had only been able to escape execution thanks to Ramirez's wife and a friend his brother wrote about the destruction of Ramirez his property and the loss of all his animals after a long wait Ramirez sent a letter back to his brother telling him he was not coming home to Jalisco this letter made it clear to his family that Ramirez had completely misunderstood his brother's letter and mistakenly believed that his wife in absence had abandoned her duties as mother and wife and left her family to ride off on Horseback to fight with the federal army against the cheros next I'd like us to take a closer look at Martin Ramirez's use of collage specifically within his Untitled piece completed in 1952 showing again how Ramirez would often create Arts with whatever materials he had available within such a restrictive environment surrounded by the thick walls of a mental hospital the situation for many patients must have been prison-like exchanges with the outside were drastically reduced and made exclusively through third parties such as Ward magazines just like a DJ or a music producer uses other tracks as quaries to give form to new ideas collage Arts functions in a very Sim similar way whether you call it collage cut and paste or sampling the practice of remains a fascinating process which Ramirez does very beautifully here as the folk art museum explains quote the the varial engineer leaning out of a window of his powerful and impressive locomotive it is a concentrated image of desire and a possibly Amorous encounter at the same time we Face a representation via an erotic setting of The mythologized Clash of the Wild and the authentic West represented here by the woman with the strength of the modern machine age represented here by the train Ramirez picked up this cliche in transferring it into his collage transformed its meaning into the opposite there is an obvious contrast between his stylish illustration of the woman on the one hand and Ramirez's simple and delightful completion of a horse and the rough hatching on the borders this contrast becomes even more acute when one recalls the conditions under which the collage was produced Ramirez had cut off all contact with his family in Mexico and remains in California he ended up confined to a mental Asylum knowing that never again would he be on a train back home thus this cheerful image of a glamorous en counter turns into a metaphor for quote this next piece unofficially titled Madonna is an intriguing addition to his body of work this in fact would just be one example of many Works depicting the image of the Madonna which is linked to a very Dee rooted cultural signific ific an the representation of a Madonna is very common in Mexican religious art and popular expression whether for institutional domestic or personal use virgins depicted in many forms abound in paintings sculptures ex votos prints medals and even tattoos on the skin Roman Catholicism in Mexico is a fusion of indigenous and European belief systems and traditions depending on ethnicity cultural region social class and Rural or Urban context Mexican dynamically as we know Ramirez created art in a very restrictive environment with barely any adequate materials it is said he often worked on the floor of his Hospital Ward choosing a studio Space barded by two twin beds and a nightstand the artists collected a variety of papers such as discarded newspapers book pages flattened paper cups and examining table cover sheets Glu them together with homemade adfs his glue recipe included potato starch bread dough and saliva it was only later after his work began to Garner notice that art supplies were given to him by Dr Pasto and Hospital staff Ramirez then collected crayons color pencils water-based paints and Poss also shoe polish and fruit juices then crushed these materials into a liquid medium that he mixed into a pot rather than use a brush he used a match stick as his form of stylus and for a straight edge he used a tongue depressor when it came to his larger scale work such as the Madonna piece we're looking at now he would stand on a table to evaluate his artwork laid out on the floor from an appropriate distance across the work we can see Blobs of swirling lines that almost Contours the lines have nearly perfect spacing indicating a sense of order that Ramirez forcibly brings to the scene as well as a Clarity and sense of control over the direction of his artistic expression while it might seem unlikely Ramirez did have an audience artist Wayne tabal remembers visiting him with art classes from a nearby College and would recount his experience quote I met him and watched him work he used little prototypes he would roll up and put in his jacket to copy like a foot or a head or a train or a Horse and Rider it seems he had a kind of series of little characters that he would bring on stage almost like a repitor company he pasted papers together with a mixture of breads from the mes hle and his saliva and would past together all kinds of bits of material of all sorts of paper he could quote in this other example of a Madonna completed between 1950 and 1953 Ramirez executes this piece in a similarly rustic setting except this time we're given subtle imagery of a setting which resembles a chapel within a church or Shrine in a workplace or home this style may be related to prints or tar Jettas common templates for artists with no dressed in a robe with Hues of celestial blue the Virgin stands on a tripod that resembles a traditional mil jet around volcanic rock artifact and common tool used since pre-colombian times to grind sources it form asserts the shape of the architectural setting are branches of Lies the flowers are always accompanied the Virgin symbolizing Purity and feathers also hold a symbolic purpose worth mentioning here feathers were sacred material used only by the highest abbility by Warriors and in the ritual deities feathers were so valuable that they were also used as materials to pay tribute in early colonial Mexican art indigenous artists use feathers to make Mosaic paintings as gift for popes Emperors and so on but while the Madonna image was frequent in his work with some examples being closely connected to an iconographic tradition some were also reimagined and altered to align with Ramirez's own creativity such as this 1950 placed in an impressive Niche framed by Garland of stylized flowers surrounded by a finely built Arch a woman with blue eyes is looking at us her hands folded as if to pray at first glance we presume we is standing in front of a Madonna but things become less obvious the closer we look for example she has blond's hair which for a Madonna depiction is extremely uncommon she wears a festive but slightly fancy shirt with red stripes and her skirt is elegant behind her we can see a blue sky stars this ignites many questions surrounding the meaning behind this example is she standing is she praying is she laid out as at awake or on the contrary very much alive is she a majestic Madonna or a beautiful American woman decorated with the Stars and Stripes could it be that Ramirez was paying homage to a loved one sadly these are all questions that will likely be left unanswered and left to interpretation yet what this drawing clearly shows is how Ramirez proceeded in his art making he based his work on an established and highly popular model adapted it to fit his own personal purposes bear in mind that this kind of technique is something pretty impressive for an untrained artists to achieve and own this next piece is a personal favorite of mine and also one of the most mysterious pieces in his body of work with the unofficial title of skele it's mysterious not just because of its unknown completion date but also the appearance of a skeleton which to anyone outside of Mexico such as myself first gives off a very grim and Eerie sensation however to Mexicans the image of skeletons and skulls hold a much deeper and more beautifully profound meaning here Ramirez depicts a skeleton playing music which is believed to be a homage to the ancient tradition of Daner d moete or Dance of Death established in the 14th century it was widely popular as a representation of the absolute power of death over human life in contemporary United States and Europe the dance of death was gradually replaced by The Cult of the Eternal Youth and paradoxically found its new subculture in Mexico the dancer Dam as imported by the Spanish conquerors met with the Aztec culture and its Cults this led to a new tradition that found its annual peak in the well-known Day of the Dead where life and death meet in a festive and almost celebratory Gathering where death is not faced with fear and anguish but instead acknowledged as a natural part of life and treated with humor in the lower part of his drawing we see a condensed representation of everyday life cars houses streets and Hills whatever happens the road takes us upward Terrace after Terrace year after year to meet with the Last Dance it seems that Ramirez is betraying death as waiting for us at the summit but it is always present playing its songs on its fiddle sometimes in the background sometimes far away but as always in the close it's hard to say what exactly inspired this imagery perhaps Ramirez was simply once again betraying his culture as a sign of reverence or respect or perhaps for whatever reason he was becoming ever more conscious of death's presence and was prompted to create this drawing but regardless it serves as a useful reminder that death is always present no matter how much we try to ignore it but it shouldn't be regarded as negative or depressing to be conscious of how precious and short our life is can potentially make our lives much more meaningful and with a label of an outsider artist his work offers a front row seat view into a unique visual language one that blends cultural memory personal struggle and an impulse his phenetic lines and reoccurring motifs I think are really themes of displacement resilience and the enduring human spirit Spirit while the circumstances surrounding his art are undeniably tragic Ramirez's Legacy lies in the undeniable power of His Creations his work stands as a testament of a transformative potential of Art in adversity Martin Ramirez may have been an outsider to the traditional art world within his artistic Universe he found a voice of profound Beauty and enduring significance that is truly in one way or another he found his freedom through the confines of a hospital walls through creativity and Imagination that not even his crippling mental health could take away from him thanks items.title: Otto Dix - An Artist of Anguish
items.summary: 19世紀末，當歐洲開始應對衝突和社會動盪的悲慘現實時，一位藝術家從工業化德國的煙囪中崛起，一位藝術家敢於面對人類狀況的原始、不加修飾的真相。奧托·迪克斯是表現主義和新客觀主義運動的大師，也是後來被納粹標記為墮落藝術的藝術風格的關鍵人物，成為藝術勇氣的燈塔。他的作品以對人類痛苦的深層、人類生命的脆弱性、人類的複雜性的內在洞察為標誌。他的藝術旅程是在第一次世界大戰的殘酷、動蕩的魏瑪共和國和拒絕浪漫化或粉飾畫筆作為手術刀的背景下展開的，細緻地剖析了人類的經歷，並揭露了其常常怪誕的弱點。在這段影片中，我們將深入探討奧托·迪克斯的一些最堅定的願景，觀眾面對的不是理想化的英雄或美麗的風景，而是士兵殘破的屍體、窮人的絕望和一個國家在這個災難性時代的道德敗壞。在這裡，我們將深入探討他的作品，從他不和諧的主題到他對戰爭、社會不平等和黑暗的赤裸裸的控訴。到這個頻道，如果您還沒有訂閱，請務必訂閱，點擊通知鈴，以跟上我關於藝術怪異和精彩的一面的更多視頻，大家歡迎來到另一個視頻。今天，我邀請您和我一起探索奧托·迪克斯出生於1891年12月2日的黑暗而具有挑戰性的畫作。他出生在一個相當樸素的家庭，他的父親是鑄鐵廠的模具製造商，迪克斯繼承了他堅強的性格和鋼藍色的眼睛。他從身為裁縫的母親那裡繼承了對音樂和詩歌的熱愛。不出所料，這讓年輕的奧托發現了他的藝術天賦，尤其是繪畫方面的天賦。10歲時，他為畫家弗里茨·阿勒斯曼當模特，他在工作室的經歷給他留下了深刻的印象，他決定在多年後的1906年至1910年間，在當地為迪克斯提供的學徒生涯中，在工藝和技術方面打下了堅實的基礎，磨練了他在油畫和粉彩方面的才能。1909年，迪克斯開始在德勒斯登美術學院學習。在這裡，缺乏嚴格的學術課程，使他能夠探索。特別是，他對古老技術的作品產生了濃厚的興趣，這些技術在他的分層油畫中創造了深度和表現力，受到荷蘭、義大利和學院範圍之外的影響。德勒斯登市充滿活力的藝術場景產生了巨大的創意產出，定期舉辦大型展覽和活動，使他能夠接觸到這些運動的原始情感和大膽的色彩，引起了奧託的共鳴，他開始將它們融入他的作品中。1913年，迪克斯遇到了文森梵谷的色彩藝術和富有表現力的筆觸，這無疑給這位年輕藝術家留下了持久的印象，他已經開始第一次透過出售小型肖像畫和風俗畫以及1914年第一次世界大戰爆發後，迪克斯的生活發生了重大轉折。他熱情地在西部的野戰砲兵團服役。然而，到了第二年，他在戰爭期間目睹的恐怖對權威的懷疑和對權威的懷疑，不用說，這些永遠困擾著他的經歷成為了一個反覆出現的經歷。戰後，迪克斯回到德勒斯登並不受歡迎。奧托·迪克斯（Otto 、宗教寓言和聖經場景等主題。1949年題為《復活》的畫作似乎代表基督從他的作品中浮現出來。至少在我看來，他這一時期最奇怪的畫作之一是他1946年的畫作，題為《調色板是黑暗而柔和的，增強了這幅畫的嚴峻情緒，喚起了一種死亡感。偶爾閃現的紅色可能像徵著血腥、暴力或廢墟的面具》這個標題是我們向世界呈現的一個強大的外觀，但在這裡它們被打破了，這些面具的面孔可以被視為代表那些經歷過戰爭的人支離破碎的身份。他1948年的畫作《Ecce Homo》，其肖像位於鐵絲網後面，在這裡，藝術家描繪了自己在鐵絲網後面，全身生瘡，坐在自己的尿液中，這是監禁和壓迫的有力像徵。標題Ecce Homo是拉丁語，意為“看那人”，是本丟彼拉多在《聖經》中所說的一句話當奧托·迪克斯在他的面前向人群展示耶穌基督時，奧托·迪克斯將自己融入到場景中，將基督的苦難與納粹迫害者的苦難以及更廣泛的等同破壞起來。奧托·迪克斯最終回到了德累斯頓，在那裡一直待到1966年。在此期間，在當時分裂的德國兩地，對他的作品的認可度再次開始上升。1959年，他被授予德意志聯邦共和國大功勳十字勳章。1950年，他被提名為國家獎，但未能成功。他在漢堡獲得了Lichtwark獎，在德累斯頓獲得了馬丁·安德森·內克瑟藝術獎，以紀念他75歲。同年，他獲得了漢斯·托馬獎，隨後又被授予了“倫勃朗獎”。1968年，他在薩爾斯堡獲得了歌德基金會的倫勃朗獎。在1969年去世之前，他完成了一幅《瑪塞拉》，據我所知，是他的孫女之一，似乎在他生命的最後幾年裡，奧托·迪克斯已經擺脫了戰爭和不公正的邪惡本質，轉向了他所尋求的更加豐富和健康的幸福。1965年完成的一幅早期畫作描繪了瑪塞拉和他的另一個孫女娜娜在花園裡。我在lamperts.com上看到的一篇關於這件作品的文章完美地詳細介紹了奧托·迪克斯在他的作品中所採用的技術，「在色彩和繪畫形式中發現的樂趣，以及在大而發光的紙張上實現的平版印刷術的重新發現，都是典型的從他的水洗技術到細節的全部明確定義，沒有計算形式化的理想構圖，沒有徹底的理想構圖的基礎上定義了他的作品。似乎在他最後的日子裡，他不再希望探索黑暗，而是專注於他的幸福和他的幸福。在這個國家的戰場和街頭承受瞭如此多的痛苦之後，這個國家不僅幻滅了他，壓迫了他，拋棄了他，囚禁了他，他可能突然而意外地死去，但並沒有。令人欣慰的是，他留下的黑暗和飽受戰爭蹂躪的形象並不是他唯一的遺產，儘管它們如此重要和令人大開眼界，但他也留下了一份溫柔他靈魂的一部分可以在這些最終的創作中得到見證，給我們一個額外寶貴的教訓，那就是永遠不要讓生命的黑暗使者完全主宰我們，即使死亡使者我們，而是用我們心中的愛，而是用我們心中的愛，非常感謝您的觀看。你發現這個影片內容豐富，我希望你渴望探索更多這個極為重要的作品。一如既往，很遺憾我不能在這個影片中包含更多他的畫作，但不要讓這阻止你探索他的藝術之旅。這個影片更多的是給你一個起點來觀察我在這個頻道上介紹的藝術家的畫作，但重要的是一如既往地有你，我期待在下面閱讀你自己的解釋。在我離開之前，我想花點時間分享一些我可愛的觀眾在我的影片結尾發送給我的一些藝術作品。今天的特色獎金藝術家是瓦倫丁，一位局外人藝術家，他在中學時用筆名朋克搖滾鬼魂更加勤奮。年底離開學校的一位藝術老師注意到了他，儘管他從未上過課，只在午餐和空閒時間在房間裡閒逛，並給了他一大堆另一本，允許學生用任何材料自由創作。這段時間讓他開始使用壓克力繪畫，發現顏料確實推進了他的進步之旅。他自己的風格是一種逃避的東西，靈感和影響激發了他對藝術的熱愛和創造力，如文森特·梵高、皮埃爾·波納爾、卡拉瓦喬、弗里達·卡羅、愛德華·霍珀、詹姆斯·恩索爾和雷內·馬格里特，只是為了直接引用他自己對自己作品的反思，引用，“我覺得我的作品總是以不合時宜的方式結束，但唉，它最終成為我的手繼續結束的東西，我的目標是試著對我來說，繪畫中最重要的元素之一是色彩世界，我發現我越來越多地嘗試用我手頭上的工具和顏料來翻譯它，我什至用一把尺子和一根縫紉針自己製作了一些用於精確細節工作的工具。瓦倫丁的第一個官方系列名為《歌謠》，他在其中解釋說，他正在大力描繪場景。他告訴我，他一直想畫那些文藝復興時期的畫作，其中所有的人物都在一起講述一個故事。例如，他的畫作《舞蹈》是一種情感，他最終不得不開始這樣做，在他個人知道瓦倫丁想到這些之後，他會說否則。「我只是唯一一個必須用繪畫來講述我希望講述的故事的模特，我目前正在創作迄今為止最大、最複雜的作品，以聖母憐子圖為主題，我情不自禁地與瓦倫丁有很多共同點，他認為我也發現自己被周圍的色彩所吸引，並在其中看到了很多可以激發如此深刻的東西，這就是為什麼我像磁鐵一樣被他的藝術所吸引，尤其是當看到他如何完美地將這些色調融合在一起，創造出如此超凡脫俗的厚厚的有紋理的油漆層投入瞭如此多的關注和關注，我覺得這確實強調了他對媒介的掌握。我認為他在這裡可以提供一些真正獨特的東西，如果您能去查看更多內容，這對我來說意義重大。請透過您在螢幕上看到的連結前往他的Instagram，或點擊描述中的連結向他展示一些內容。如果您也是藝術家，並且希望有可能出現在即將發布的影片中，請向我發送一封電子郵件，其中包含有關您和您的藝術的描述以及您的作品範例，或在Instagram上向我發送訊息。最後，我要向一直以來支持Patreon和頻道會員選項卡的用戶表示衷心的感謝。在此向我所有的頂級Carol H和Charlie Sanchezy致敬。今天的內容就到此為止了。

items.title: The Dark World of Odilon Redon
items.summary: the work of French artist odilon redon regarded as one of the most important original symbolists of the late 19th early 20th centuries defies easy categorization his work transcends the movements blending elements of symbolism surrealism and even hints of imp impressionism through his exploration of Dreams imagination and the subconscious redon is most well known for his body of monochromatic artwork that exploited the expressive and suggested powers of the color black known as the Noir series although many other more colorful works of his would be just as compelling and unsettling it is his Sinister black charcoal Noir drawings that seem to tap deep into the Curiosity of many art enthusiast when they hear the name of odilon redon primarily for their intimate connection to the Hidden Side of Ron's mind that he would creatively willingly put on display for viewers experience in this video we will delve into that very same experience together by taking a close look at some of redon's Most Fascinating pieces within his Noir series to unravel the Mysteries that lie within many of the strange bring to life whether depicting Landscapes or ethereal figures many compositions of his within this morbidly alluring series invite us to embark on a journey of pure introspection and contemplation but since his talent transcends his use of charcoal alone particularly in his later work we also be taking a quick look at some of his other paintings and pastel drawings as well as I feel there is still much that we can explore within his more abstract vibrant World which he created alongside his darker work his ability to go beyond the confines of reality and evoke a sense of wonder continued to inspire generations of artists and art fans alike including me someone who loves to create art with charcoal and pastel myself who regards him as a very big influence as well as some viewers on this channel who I noticed suggested that I cover this artist someday and I guess now is that time please be sure to subscribe and hit the notification Bell for more videos from me on the weird and wonderful side of the art world and of course welcome to another video my friends join me as we embark on a journey into the mystical Realms of redon's imagination where the boundaries between the conscious and the subconscious blur and the mysteries of odilon redon born bertran Jean redon on April 20th 1840 in Bordeaux France was raised in a cultured bouro family the wealth of his family ripened from rather unfortunate Roots however as his father made his fortune through the slave trades in Louisiana during the 1830s redon initially pursued a career in architecture studying briefly under Jean Leon Bona in Paris however his true passion lay in the realm of art showing fine promise at drawing at a young age he soon abandoned architecture to dedicate himself fully to creating art redon's early Artistic Endeavors were influenced by The Works of romantic and symbolist movements as well as by his encounters with the literary and philosophical occurrence of his time he etching developing a distinctive style characterized by a delicate balance between light and Shadow and an emphasis on imaginative subject matter in the 1870s after returning from his service in the Franco Prussian War until its end in 1871 redon work meticulously in refining his style he eventually began to gain recognition for his series of charcoal drawings known as the noirs which depicted Fantastical and often macb imagery inspired by his dreams and inner Visions by the 1880s these Works attracted the attention of influential writers and artists including jolis car huisman who championed Ron's unique artistic Vision including his drawings his cult novel titled Aro or against English throughout his career redon continued to evolve as an artist experimenting with color and form in his later pastol and oil pieces his imagery ranged from Haunting Landscapes and mysterious figures to Vivid depictions of flowers and other natural elements all imbued with a sense of Otherworldly Beauty and mystery by the beginning of a 1900s after seemingly abandoning his dark and Moody charcoal drawings Al together for more abstract paintings recognized with numerous exhibitions and accolades including the Legion of Honor in 1903 and the salon D dor in 1904 despite his growing reputation redon remained a private and let his art speak for itself rather than notoriety and it was around this time that another curious development in his style began to emerge which was his Keen interest in Hinduism and Buddhism as well as their cultures which increasingly showed in his work most notably his piece titled the Buddha completed in 1905 which features what appears to be the Japanese interpretation of the Buddha of infinite light and life named amitaba the central Buddha of devotion within the pure land sect of Buddhism that flourished as the new century continued odilon passed away on July 6th 1916 leaving behind a legacy that continues to inspire and Intrigue artists and art enthusiasts around the world his exploration of inner depths of a human psyche and his ability to evoke a sense of wonder and mystery through his art ensure that his work remains as relevant and captivating today as it was first I'd like us to take a look at one of his earlier pieces within his Noir collection titled Guardian Spirit of the 1878 this charcoal composition seems to grab the viewers attention immediately with what could only be described as a large head of in the sky above a calm ocean with equally large yet downwards towards a sailboat with surrounding goals flitting about and waves the sea stretches far out to a featureless horizon presenting us with vastness if you look closer you can just about make out a delicate looking Halo that surrounds the head as well as what appears to be a wing on the far left given this strange head a character of being Angelic or like a Divine being whilst also maintaining a degree of ominous domination over the environment below according to One Source I came across when the artist's father Bernard redon was a young man he traveled from France to Louisiana in order to try and recoup the family's lost wealth that he had accumulated in the slave train while there he met and married redon's mother odil on their later return to France odil was pregnant with odilo who Bordeaux the artist often regretted that he was not born at Sea an environment that odilon himself described as quote a place without a country on an abyss with this in mind perhaps this work could be seen as representing a kind of alternative birth for Lon perhaps the large head in the sky is actually a self-portrait of his destined or even desired emergence into the world as he always envisioned it's of course hard to say for sure but the strange foreshadows a surrealist style that throughout the 20th century in which such imagery invites the viewer to ask this as for the technical aspects of this piece the drawing is very typical of redon's noirs in which he manipulated the charcoal Medium as well as merely applying it to paper in order to achieve the array of tones and textures that we can see such techniques that he would Master included wiping stumping smudging even adding touches of chalk to highlights most notably around the eye of a head facing a viewer which seems to have a distin inve glowing ring around it as if caught in the light beam of the sun which again emphasizes the Heavenly benevolent aura that seems to emanate from this being watching quietly above this next piece which I consider to be one of his most gripping when I first saw it is simply titled Apparition with a slightly uncertain completion 1890 this would in fact be one of other artworks that shared this title which included his later piece under the same name completed in 1910 featuring an abstract floral display and two ghostly white figures walking down a hazy staircase on the right presenting both a mysterious atmosphere accompanied by a disorientating Cascade of color in this earlier work though the atmosphere is nothing short of sheer threat and Dread there are heavy deposits of charcoal spread across the paper like Black Rain with the mysterious face of a bearded man peering through on the right with dark sunken eyes the ambiguity of a figure's identity and significance is one of the most striking aspects of its work is it a ghost a spirit or simply a this open to interpretation inviting viewers to emoke moods and emotions rather than trying to depict a concrete subject there is again though a slight strange element of divine energy that seems to emanate from this figure at least for me perhaps it's just the beard expression on his face in spite of of a dark chaos around him but he almost appears to look like Jesus Christ which when looking at other examples of rayon's work even within other Noir drawings depictions of Christ would not be a stranger to his collection regardless of the exact identity the figure's ghostly appearance suggests a presence from Beyond the realm of living hinting at themes of mortality spirituality and the unknown Ron was deeply influenced by the writings and imagery used within the short stories of Edgar alen Poe and other Gothic writers whose themes would often leak into the work of radons furthermore the composition of apparition adds to its enigmatic atmosphere the figure is positioned slightly off center creating a sense of imbalance and tension the use of negative space and Shadow further emphasizes the Eerie mood drawing the viewer's Gaze towards a mysterious figure at the edge of a work with the darkness and Shadow also being a key character in itself alongside the figure through its dreamlike imagery Supernatural atmosphere the drawing is a prime example of redon's invitation to viewers to explore the depths of their own imagination and subconscious making it both a haunting display but a the next charcoal drawing is titled cactus man completed between 1881 and 1882 the drawing to picks a man's head emerging from a decorative Square flower pot the head itself is also covered in menacing looking spikes resembling that cactus his expression seems to be one of observation with large somewhat dull eyes and full lips the flower pot although quite tricky to make out is decorated with an image of an Amazon slaying a man referencing the Greek myth of his female warriors whose conflation of feminine and masculine traits poetically Echoes Circ conflation of human and plant forms presented to us in drawing although again it is open to personal perspective I can't help but get the impression that this drawing presenting the merge of human and plant perception of boundaries between the human world and the natural world this blurring could represent a connection to Nature a vulnerability to its harshness or perhaps a potential for growth and resilience the cactus spikes emerging from the man's head evoke for suffering of Christ's Crown of Thorns suggesting themes of sacrifice endurance and the potential for beauty to emerge from Pain the image of the Amazon on the flower pot known for their strength and Defiance of traditional gender roles jux opposes for seemingly passive portrayal of a man this could be interpreted as a commentary on the societal expectations of masculinity or a broader exploration of gender fluidity in addition perhaps the figure solitary confinement in the partt and his large observant eyes introspection and a silent awareness of a world around him one other interpretation I came across which I found quite surprising explores the potential influence of redon's exposure to an exhibition showcasing the indigenous people of Tiara def go an archipelago at the southernmost tip of South America who had a profound if not complicated impact on the artist and whom he described as being quote hay grotesque on the one hand he also reportedly admired the Purity and simplicity of a so-called primitive people while on the other hand he recognized them as the Fearsome Origins with with a decorative flower pot a symbol of Western culture and containment Ron's hybrid cactus man can be understood as an attempt to reconcile the two poles of human existence nature and culture wild and civilized but of course and I can't stress this enough the complexities of such an interpretation require careful sensitivity it's important to remember that this was an artist whose father was a slave trader during a very different time in history to today where many Europeans had a rather shall we say warped view of native people so if we're going to take an interpretation like this into account it's vital to understand the circumstances and nature of Ron's generation and upbringing in any case by examining the various symbols and their potential meanings cactus man allows us to delve into the themes of human connection to Nature the complexities of human experience and the power of art to evoke emotions and contemplation next we have the charcoal 1882 titled the eye like a strange Infinity it is the first plate from a 10-part series titled aned Capo once again inspired by The Works of the po the artwork features a single disembodied eye morphed into a strange shape of a hot air balloon it's upward gazing Iris and pupil resembling a dark dark pulsating void the eye is depicted as detached from its owner floating freely against a hazy background of clouds instead of a basket containing passengers the balloon carries what looks like a severed head on a platter much like that of St John the Baptist in the biblical story of Salon in the lower left the FRS of a lonely palm-like plant are appearing Out of the Shadows the central eye is often interpreted as a symbol of a human mind specifically aspects from my personal point of view this disembodied nature might suggest a separation from the physical world delving into the Realms of Dreams introspection the many faint ropes attaching to the eye can be seen as between the conscious and an unconscious mind or the fragile nature of human perception the balloon-like quality of the eye might further suggest a sense of Ascension or the desire of journeying referencing the vastness of the human psyche or the mysteries of the universe the Cloudy backgrounds adds to the dreamlike and ethereal quality of the artwork the eyeball disassociated from the physical body could be seen as a symbol for freedom from the constraints of everyday life and the attainment of a Consciousness according to scholar and Creator jod hunman quote floating up towards Infinity let loose from the limitations of body and mind Ron's eyes are free to really see beyond reality Beyond nature beyond the visible end the connection to edar Alan Poe is also significant Po's work often explored themes of Darkness the Supernatural and the exploration of a human psyche these themes resonate with the symbolist elements presented in radon's artwork the eyes unsettling gaze and its Journey towards Infinity evoke a sense of mystery introspection and the potential for encountering the unknown that mirrors the introspective and often writing overall this artwork truly is imagery it delves into the complexities of a human mind and invites viewers to consider the vastness of the Unseen and next we have redon's infinite search 1886 a lithograph that captures yet more elements in this work the dominating image is that of a figure with strands of straw-like hair and exaggerated facial features overlooking what looks like some kind of chalice emitting Vapor or smoke that climbs to the ceiling of an ancient looking room almost reminiscent of a medieval castle or a church this figure to me almost resembles a witch experimenting with Alchemy in the dead of night she appears to be in a state of contemplation focusing on the Chalice or perhaps searching for something intangible as suggested by the title The Infinite search the figure's elongated form warped facial features and sinuous Contours evoke a sense of movement and transformation suggesting a state of metamorphosis as is typical of Ron's work that we've already seen symbolism plays a significant role in the infinite search the nocturnal setting and the figure solitary Journey evoke a sense of existential angst and the Quest for meaning in the face of mystery the mysterious leaving more questions and answers and a complex Melting Pot of moods it wouldn't surprise me though if this was exactly what redon intended let's now take a look at one of drawings the 1887 piece simply tied spider the drawing features a rather large spider with a fuzzy looking body 10 legs instead of the usual eight it most striking feature is its very humanlike facial features consisting of a snub nose and a wide smiling mouth that reveals a row of tiny white teeth creating a strange and paradoxical image from the way the spider is tilted it gives off the impression that the spider is descending from a thread of its web from the ceiling down to what looks like floor much like the images of Christ spiders have appeared before in his work with equally bizarre blends of arachnet human features Ron based this particular print upon an earlier charcoal drawing but the lithographic medium which uses greasy ink or crayon applied directly to a smooth Stone was equally well suited to the artist exploration of the color black for me I immediately get the sense that the spider with its additional legs and human smile suggests a creature from the realm of Dreams nightmares or the subconscious the smile a symbol of joy friendliness just opposed with the spider a creature often associated with fear and danger creates an interesting Duality this reflects the complexities of human nature and the potential for both good and evil within us the spider might represent hidden fears or anxieties that lurk beneath the surface of our Consciousness or perhaps himself the act of drawing it out and giving it form even a seemingly playful one could be a way for ridon to confront these fears much like the cactus man this work blurs the lines between the natural world that being The Spider and the human world with its humanlike smile this reflects a common theme in symbolism where artists explored the imaginative and subjective experience of reality to create an image that is totally Fantastical it comes to little surprise that raidon was reportedly fascinated with the Natural Sciences and with the encouragement of his friend the botanist arong clev he studied Anatomy oology and microscopic life he also frequently visited paris's Museum of Natural History which included exhibits of biological abnormalities and he even lectures it seems that many of these beasts and monsters that appear in his work could well have been based on observation but were mutated by his imagination The Smiling spider serves as a wonderful recognition of our Humanity in these strange hybrid creatures the almost inherent human fear of spiders mixed with the playful grin of a fuzzy spider makes images like this both appealing and unsettling at the same time another unnerving example of r On's Noir is titled before I saw the vaporous Contours of a human form another 1896 like an image straight out of a ghost story this piece is incredibly chilling interestingly enough this image was in fact used as part of a series inspired by a ghost story The Haunted the haunters by Edward bullwood Litton leaving us with some confidence supernatural the title itself Sparks curiosity it hints at a mysterious Vision a revelation where a human form emerges from something undefined it may even be a direct quote and experience of himself the central image is a white hazy and wispy form that suggests a human figure is not a clear impressionistic blur the figure sits in a dark room where we can see in the background two staring eyes gazing towards us and the figure from the darkness which leaves us with a puzzling uncomfortable question is the ghost the seated hazy figure in front or is it the eyes that we can see in the shadows without a doubt many of rayon's Noir drawings capture the most Intrigue within the vast collection of his artwork but there are still some wonderful examples of his more colorful work that capture the same level of Fascination so for the rest of this video I'd like us to take a look at some of rayon's pastel and oil paintings to not only observe his versatility as an artist but also explore the same degree of mystery that he accomplishes Within for example his piece titled figure 1876 interestingly seems to almost capture the same themes and moods as this first piece we looked at Guardian waters we're once again presented with a large head suspended in the air with the aid of angel-like wings against a beautiful setting all Rising Sun behind it is an elegant woman who seems to be holding the disembodied head with the ease of drying and washing the orange glowing sun behind feels similarly omnipotent the way it seems to fill the entire background puts an end to any sense of the outward exterior perspective unlike guardian of a spirit Waters the expression of a head in this work looks off with an expression of irony as explains in a very poetic article on this work written by Tom Quay which I thought would be worth sharing quote its Stern jaw detailed with an Earthly Simplicity Contours Stern and strong as the holder's own face is scrolled with an alarming shity the head gazes off beyond the image to elsewhere she is not concerned with the situation suggests that neither should you be rather the real Marvel here is the palet of figure it's drying radiating heat that folds over the image with a wicked Hue below the duo a crispy Bracken Falls seemingly glowing from within with an quote oron red on stag from 1900 is a captivating exploration of the inner World while the pastel drawing defies contribute to its dreamlike atmosphere symbolic meaning the central figure is a woman with flowing dark hair her eyes in a state of serene contemplation her ghostly form suggests an ethereal presence existing beyond the confines of a physical world she appears to reside within a boundless cloudy space rendered in a soft pallet of Blues Reds and yellows further emphasizing the everchanging and unsolid quality of daydreaming her relaxed and almost again a state of introspection where the blur the absence of a defined background allows a viewer to project their own interpretations and emotions onto the music believing it held the key to unlocking the depths of a human psyche he saw rat as a visual manifestation of the emotions and experiences evoked by music while Daydream doesn't depict any literal musical elements the swirling forms and soft colors evoke a sense of Harmony and flow reminiscing of a soundscape this connection is further strengthened by Ron's own writings where he expressed the limitations of color in capturing the essence of Music which he experience as we'll see in the next piece titled parul completed in 1912 even within redon's work that included color dark and morbid themes would still occasionally creep up to the surface with a similar yet Bleaker style to that of Daydream this gripping image of a solitary figure up against a lonely mountainous landscape is believed to be inspired by Vagner 3 Act 1882 Opera under the same name inspired by The Legend of a Holy Grail where on revisits the theme of his early ol lithograph 1892 in this version though redon's paral deviates significantly from the typical portrayals here the warrior has been stripped of his armor his helmet Lance transformed into a more introspective figure perhaps Aus a wise man or Seer this is evident in his solitary pose and the contemplative isolation the background is Stark featuring bare mountains rendered in somber tones of violet and black this internal State one devoid of comfort or items.summary: it almost begs belief when looking through the paintings of Eve tongi that such perfect technique of dramatic lighting and shadows cold atmospheres such organic looking imagery could be achieved by an artist that had little to no formal training in art whatsoever stepping into a painting by Eve tongi is akin to traversing the threshold of a dream ape where biomorphic shapes morph into impossible Landscapes bathed in an unsettling yet strangely alluring light his canvases imbued with the spirit of surrealism transport us to the Realms where logic surrenders to the Fantastical and the Supreme to analyze Toni's art is to embark on a voyage of Discovery ambiguous forms each whispering imagination in this video we will delve into the captivating world of some of their unique visual language and exploring the artistic influences that shape them we will journey through recurring themes in his work such as the interplay between vastness and intimacy the unsettling beauty of Decay and the enigmatic presence of Shadows we will Auto examine tongi relationship with the surrealist movement analyzing how his individual voice resonated with the subconscious don't forget to subscribe hit the notification Bell to see more videos from me on the weird and wonderful side of art welcome to another video everyone and prepared to be bewildered intrigued and perhaps even challenged as we navigate through the born on the 5th of January 1900 in Paris Eve Toni's life like his paintings unfolded in a series of dramatic forms tragedy would strike him and his family from an early age with his father dying in 1908 and his brother being killed during the first world war as as he Grew Older he gravitated towards the sea spending time on Merchant ships and later finding inspiration in its vastness and mystery in 1920 he was conscripted into the French army in Tunis where he met the poet Shak PR who was apparently amused by Toni's eccentric and strange habits from chewing his socks to eating live spiders the latter became a party trick that he it was a vibrant partisan art scene during this decade that truly began to shift him towards the art World a life-changing encounter with the georgo 1923 sparked Toni's artistic Journey drawn to the surrealist movement's exploration of a subconscious and the irrational he quickly found himself surrounded by the likes of Andre Breton mcgr despite having no formal training t I's Unique Style blossomed characterized shapes Barren Landscapes bathed in ethereal light and a sense of suspended animation his paintings with titles like indefinite divisibility for example or through Birds through fire but not through glass invited viewers to abandon conventional logic and delve into forms he became a key figure in gaining critical Acclaim for his 1939 Love Led tongi across the Atlantic where he met and married fellow artist case Sage who shared a relatively similar style to tongi and who I think May in fact also be worth exploring on someday settling in Connecticut tongi continue to paint prolifically finding inspiration in the American landscape while retaining his distinct European influence style during World War II he became a vocal advocate for exiled artists and participated in exhibitions alongside other European surrealists who sought refuge in the United States Toni's influence extended beyond the art World inspiring filmmakers like Alfred Hitchcock and other famous surrealists like Salvador Dar despite Toni remained humble and dedicated to his craft sadly he passed away in 1955 after suffering a fatal stroke leaving behind a rich Legacy of paintings that continue to Captivate and the first painting we'll be looking at today is titled mama papa is wounded 1927 one of Toni's earliest masterpieces this work invites both admiration and perplexity his enigmatic unrelated objects demands more than a fleeting glance so let's try looking deeper and unveil the layers of of meaning hidden within it dominating the canvas is a vast empty space bathed in an eerie grayish violet light this Dio's work casts long ominous Shadows contributing to an overall sense of unease the barren desert-like terrain evokes a post-apocalyptic Wasteland a world stripped of comfort and scattered across a desolate landscape are several curious objects seemingly defying conventional logic a looming cactus-like form Tethered to a webike structure appears neither fully free or imprisoned what appear to be what could only be described as beans or Pebbles are scattered in different locations in the landscape casting dramatic Shadows onto the ground a tall trunk or stalk of a plant covered in spikes appears on the right with an ominous dark black mass behind it which looks like smoke or a raincloud there is also what looks like the shape of a torso that lies abandoned on the trunk of spikes is also a subtle sight of a green string wrapped around it giving off the impression of a snake winding itself around a branch in the distance there is a strange pale pole that winds and bends seems to be disintegrating into the wind next to it almost appears like the shape of a ghost emerging from the ground with two dark Bey contribute to the painting's Dreamlight quality further blurring the lines imagination adding to the Enigma is the evocative title mama papa is wounded does it reference an actual event a primal fear or perhaps a collective Society given its open-ended nature the interpretations due to what we already know of his beloved Fallen brother some see it as a reflection of the anxiety violence that followed World War I whilst others perceive a Freudian desires Accord according to one Theory I came across the yellow figure can be interpreted as the papa the cactus as the mama and the amorphous mass as a child a family fractured and vulnerable in the face of an unknown threat though personally I see it slightly differently I see the ominous dark Mass emerging from the right to be the threat itself whilst the landscape is creeping in on to be a plateau of the mind and the difference scattered objects to be a series of different emotions such as hopelessness loneliness vulnerability or the feeling of being trapped which could be emphasized by the cactus that appears to be tied down ultimately this painting transcends a singular interpretation its power lies in its ability to evoke emotions and narratives the desolate landscape serves as a canvas for our own an anxieties and fears inviting us to confront the fragility of existence and the potential for pain within even the most basic relationships I should also point out by the way that this analysis is just one possible interpretation of the painting The Beauty of art like this lies in its subjectivity and each viewer may find their own unique meaning within its enigmatic depths and that's actually something I'd love to hear from you if you have another interpretation or notice something I may have missed so please let me know in the comments below this next work called Noya iner painted in 1929 stands as another prime example of Toni's early surrealist style while the title again offers little to no explanation the painting itself with the minimal and dark imagery it contains radiates a really strong Aura of mystery Intrigue that's very much worth exploring the canvas is dominated by Inky Blackness creating a sense of vastness against this void four biomorphic forms float Defying Gravity identification are they organic growths techn logical relics or products of a subconscious the ambiguity fuels the imagination and as for the cental motif a wispy pale structure occupies the space reminiscent of a ghost or strands smoke light seems to emanate from forms this play of light reinforces the dreamlike quality and creates a sense of depth within the flat canvas a common interpretation you may come across for this piece surrounds Toni's frequent goal to tap the unconscious mind and create dreamlike imagery Noya indaver embodies this perfectly offering a thoughts and desires unburdened by Logic Reason notably KL young a leading purchased the painting in 1929 during a time when Eve tongi was practically unknown to the art world he personally saw it as reflecting human Detachment bleakness potentially influenced by the anxieties of the inter War period young kept it in his study where it influenced and maybe even helped Inspire his theory of a collective 1958 of course tongi himself ultimately left his Works open to interpretation stating that he aimed to voke emotions rather than convey specific messages the viewer is lured in to project their own experiences and feelings onto the canvas finding personal meaning within the ambiguity in terms of technique tongi meticulously rendered the forms with heightening the contrast with their nature this painting stands out as more focused on biomorphic forms and though as we see shortly his later works elements Noya IND deference serves as a powerful and enigmatic work capturing the essence of his creativity and even his most primitive years it haunting connection to the subconscious mind continues to invoke and Inspire it's a real Testament to Toni's ability to translate the dream world into a 1942 plunges us into a realm where recognizable objects morph into strange forms and the familiar landscape devolves into the unknown here tongi paint means not only to depict reality to again evoke our emotions and ignite the viewer's imagination without without any real planning or forethought as he explained himself quote the painting develops before my eyes unfolding its surprises as it quote the composition unfolds like a desolate Beach at Twilight Sandy expanses stretch towards a hazy Horizon immersed in a skylight background while strange biomorphic shapes dominate the resemble petrified bones or eroded Shadows these ambiguous objects defy between the organic and the mechanical artificial the scene is is bathed in an unsettling light a warm glow emanates from our right highlighting the textures Contours of the forms yet this light creates dark contrasts emphasizing the shadows and contributing to the atmosphere is it Dawn breaking or dusk settling the ambiguity adds to the sense of mystery and fluidity of time tongi weaves familiar objects into the seen adding a layer of playful in congruity such as propeller blades bowls of water scattered across the landscape a rusty clamp that sits precariously structure these everyday items stripped of their original contexts become their own characters in this Dreamscape their presence invites viewers to create their own narratives and to decipher hidden meanings within the painting the title indefinite divisibility hints at The painting's Core theme the scene seems endlessly divisible each detail capable of further interpretation and each object could either be attached or infused in some way or simply as one with each other eliminating a sense of Duality the organic forms appear porous suggesting they could fragment further are fluid and meaning is multi-layered according to a wonderfully indepth analysis of his piece on interpretations we can take into account for example Lucien Freud when viewing his painting noted the heightened anxiety created by his use of depaso meaning the state of disorientation experienced in dreams was a form of Illusions as for tongi it was a source of power it's key to remember that many of the most successful surrealists celebrated Madness as both an Liberation Andre Breton said once that in dreams you could kill fly faster love to your heart's content interestingly in 1950 the psychological Institute of Vienna displayed Toni's paintings beside those of schiz frenic patients to see if a public could distinguish between the two as it turns out they could not and this result was one that delighted the surrealists Breton believed that one day Toni's images quote will be made clear with a language that is not yet understood but which people are soon going to read which they are going to talk and which they are going to perceive is best adapted to the new just a painting is an invitation to explore the impossible and the Realms of light Shadow and ambiguous forms to create an unsettling yet captivating atmosphere as surreal art very well should do this work continues to challenge viewers to question their perceptions and delve into the depths of now let's take a look at what could fairly be considered as one of Eve Toni's most famous works in his 1943 painting titled through Birds through glass the painting features strange organic shapes reminiscent of Bones rocks and melted wax these forms defy categorization once again and create a sense of unease and wonder the fiery Reds and oranges beautifully clash with the icy blues and Grays creating a tension that reflects the duality of the title although again the source of light is unclear the contrasting light and shadow it creates add unsettling depth mystery to the scene stones and wheel spokes defy gravity floating in the air like impossible Dreams a tower-like formation composed of balloon shapes giving off the impression of an enigmatic Monument made of molten metal poured into ice cold water the lack of human figures emphasizes the isolation vastness of a landscape and of course the title hints at multiple suggests that freedom and transformation require facing danger but fragility poses a limit maybe it implies that inspiration interpreted as fire and communication interpreted as birds can glass but require considerable effort the title could be Toni's personal reflection on overcoming challenges in his efforts to explore the subconscious Andre Breton stated that tongi quote condensed a few pure elements of matter meeting together and glowing suddenly like particles of dust dancing in a quote when keeping what Breton said into consideration when viewing this piece it truly heightens the concept of how the individual self and the external world are in a constant state of through glass is considered a masterpiece in its own right his captivating imagery and title challenges our perception of reality showing bluntly how the inner and outer worlds are constantly at odds with each other reminding us that there is certainly a physical world outside our minds but how it truly definitively appears can never really be determined only the mind of Eve Toni's Rose of the Four Winds painted in 1950 is a complex and evocative work that embodies the characteristics of his latest style while offering a Fantastical landscape it departs from the Vivid colors and dreamlike softness of his earlier Works presenting a more unsettling and fragmented scene and consisting of a palette the dominant feature is a towering structure on the left reminiscent of a Gothic Cathedral yet composed of a halfhazard assemblage of spiky objects bones and mineral formations like a futuristic place of worship this unsettling Fusion of organic and inorganic materials creates a sense of instability as if despite its dominating presence over a surrounding chaos below it's still delicate able to moment the ground is littered with Jagged debris resembling the rubble of a destroyed City the Steely gray and pink sky adds to the apocalyptic atmosphere evoking feelings of alienation and contrasts with the title Rose hinting a potential Beauty Beyond the immediate despair the scene is bathed in an ominous Cold Light and accentuates for textures this harsh illumination is heightened and emphasizes the stark contrast between the Towering structure landscape Shadow seems to play a pivotal role creating pockets of mystery and hiding potential Secrets within the several interpretations of row of Four Winds exist out there considering that this was painted shortly after World War II the work might reflect the artist's destruction The Bleak landcape and fractured Tower could symbolize the devastation left behind by the conflict the JX position of the imposing Tower and the chaotic landscape may represent the struggle between order and Freedom the title of rose of the Four Winds could symbolize a force of nature lifegiving finally I'd like us to take a look at Toni's very last painting completed just months before his death titled multiplication of the arcs 1954 this work is not only beautiful but a complex tapestry woven with undertones to fully appreciate it let's depths dominated by a vast foreground a looming stormy sky the painting isolation curiously instead of Toni's usual towering structures that were prevalent in a lot of his most famous works here we see fragmented biomorphic shapes resembling bones Pebbles and organic remains scattered across the ground with no dominating structure in symbols of authority the absence of such a structure suggests Decay fragility and mortality considering the timing of a foreshadowing of what awaited the artist earthy Browns yellows and Grays create a melancolic atmosphere while subtle shades of blue offer a glimmer of desires and fears in surrealism here they hint at a connection to the natural impermanence the title refers to the repeated motifs suggesting an abundance of Poss possibilities even in the landscape the play of light and Shadow creates a sense of mystery and depth inviting a viewer to endlessly explore further in terms of this introspective landscape this could be seen as tongi acknowledging both the finitude of life the potential for Renewal within cycles once again the desolate landscape might reflect concerns about the war to destruction and the fragility of human civilization but despite its melancholic undertones the open landscape and subtle light offer a sense of openness and continuity a sense of an ending to which is also endless nonetheless a horizon hidden from view an exponential Journey potential but to be honest with you I feel almost inappropriate for analyzing art like this at times because I really want to emphasize that point of infinite potential which is truly the heart and soul of Toni's work in reality there really are no right or wrong answers tongi embraced the automatic painting drawing technique letting his hand guide the brush allowing for spontaneous unconscious expression so I could interpret his work till the cows come home but will it get us any closer to a definitive answer absolutely not that's like I mentioned in the first painting there may be some details I missed or instances where I've just been overthinking and your interpretations no matter how different they are to mine all the other theories I've uncovered from my research for these paintings should be considered just as valid just because I or someone far better trained in art than me or even someone who new tongi personally can give an interpretation we shouldn't just take it a work of art should be thoroughly investigated by the individual and interpretations of others should be scrutinized so that one may come to their own understanding it's better to think of this video as just a seed that needs watering a finger pointing the way to someone's own experience of Toni's work rather than just taking them straight there Eve tongi not only unconsciously expressed himself in his art a technique that would be adopted by the likes of Jackson Pollock and Mark Rothco but he also executed his paintings with such striking detail in realism I don't think even Salvador Dar accomplished such a skill in his art in fact it's well documented that darly owes a lot of his style to tongi at one point Dary once told Toni's niece Agnes quote I pinched everything from your uncle Eve which to me is what really makes him stand out in the world of surrealism this his concepts are brimming with imagery yet also strikingly minimal simple yet so vast complexity but where Dar was notably
